purpose: Teach: 各人/個々人/同国/番手/会期/座談/顔面/おこなう

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、各人の目標設定を明確にしろ
lines.en: Make sure each person's targets are clearly defined.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative opening. Direct command tone. No wasted breath. Eyes level. Expectation of compliance is built into the phrasing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。個々人の能力評価を丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Understood. We'll conduct careful individual assessments of each person's capabilities.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Slight nod in the voice. Slightly slower pace to show conscientiousness. Closing with quiet assurance — he's taking this on.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、同国の競合分析を進めろ
lines.en: And run a competitive analysis against rival companies in the same market.
lines.style: Continuing the command without pause. Same brisk tempo. Slight emphasis on 'same market' — clarifying the scope. No question mark in the air.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界番手の位置を再確認します
lines.en: Yes. I'll reconfirm our position in the industry ranking.
lines.style: Acknowledging the additional task. Slight quickening to show he's absorbing layered instructions. Small, competent nod in the tone. Efficient.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 国会の会期内に対応する必要がある
lines.en: It needs to be done before the parliamentary session ends.
lines.style: Sharper edge now — urgency added. Leaning forward slightly in the voice. The deadline lands with weight. Still controlled, but the time pressure is clear.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。役員座談会を企画します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the schedule for an executive roundtable discussion.
lines.style: Moving into action mode. Faster than before — he's already working the problem. Brief, competent. The assurance that this will get done is implicit in the pace.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員顔面の表情管理研修も検討しろ
lines.en: Also consider a training program for staff on professional presentation and composure.
lines.style: Final directive. Slightly softer than the others — 'also consider' opens a bit more room for input than the hard commands. Still authoritatively phrased. A check on comprehensiveness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員研修をおこなう日程を調整します
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange the schedule for the staff training program.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slightly longer breath — showing he's completed the mental list. Calm, assured close. He's got it all now.
